name: Our Lady and St Gerard Majella, Lostock Hall
shortName: Our Lady and St Gerard Majella
note: Part of this parish lies within Liverpool Archdiocese, but is served from the Diocese of Salford, by a Benedictine community.

boundary.description:
WITHIN THE DIOCESE OF SALFORD.
From Middleforth Hall on Factory Lane at the Diocesan Boundary E by the public footpath to and along the old tram road to and S by Todd Lane North to Todd Lane South to Stone Bridge over the River Lostock and W by the river Lostock to the Diocesan boundary.
WITHIN THE ARCHDIOCESE OF LIVERPOOL.
From Middleforth Hall on Factory Lane E to the Old Tram Road and S along its course to Todd Lane North then S to Todd Lane South to the River Lostock at Stone Bridge then by the River Lostock W to Fowler Lane Bridge then NW by Church Lane to its junction with Coote Lane then SW in a straight line to Naptha Cottage then NW to the junction of Chain House Lane and Newgate Lane then NE to Crooks Farm on Bee Lane then E by this to the railway line and by this N to Middleforth Hall on Factory Lane.

supplementaryNote.title: Parish is served by a Benedictine Community.
